name: Binary All-to-All Communication
definition: An optimized all-to-all communication algorithm used to maintain an up-to-date image of the entire cluster memory state (array of keys) on each rendering node, replacing pre-determined page positions.
summary: Binary All-to-All Communication is a distributed algorithm that gathers all cluster keys on every node using logarithmic steps, outperforming the linear ring approach by reducing communication latency.
